description: Store Indya is committed to promote and support the priceless craftsmanship of Indian artisans by providing them an international platform, where their talent can be displayed for the glory and recognition they richly deserve.

Carving in natural stone is an art form which has a very strong tradition in India. From the beautiful temple sculptures chiseled to perfection in natural stones present all over India to the pristine beauty of marble sculpting and inlay work like the Taj Mahal is a standing example of the superiority of workmanship of the Indian artisan. Rajasthan and Agra are Centres of stone craft in Northern India.
Natural materials like soapstone, sand stone or marble are chiseled and finished into perfection to give you the most exquisite carved stone products.
